name: Slide
description: Recreation of the CapCut "Slide" animation. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

params.name: progress
params.description: 0 = start of the in animation, 1 = the untouched clip. Use 1 - progress for an out animation

params.name: distance
params.description: How far the picture travels, in frames; it wraps by mirroring

params.name: motion_blur
params.description: Motion blur per unit of speed
